title: New options for speech, text, and images
summary:
New speech, text, and image models joined the garden, while CatGPT got Pollinations login and public user data gained a read-only endpoint.

Seraphyn joined as a community provider with alpha `qwen3-tts` speech and `openai-seraphyn` text models. The alpha `dirtberry-pro` model adds another text-to-image option for realistic images, pixel art, and complex scenes. FLUX.2 Klein 4B moved to a different provider and is now marked alpha; its image-input support remains listed.

CatGPT added Pollinations login for meme generation, selfie uploads through the Pollinations media store, and an account view showing Pollen balance. It also got a lighter theme and the original CatGPT comic in its header. Gratisfy joined the app catalog with unified access to free inference providers, benchmarks, and provider discovery.

The new `d1_user_public` Tinybird endpoint queries the latest synced user snapshot for fields including names, GitHub identifiers, and tiers. It excludes emails and balances.

daily.title: Qwen speech joins the API
daily.text: The alpha `qwen3-tts` model generates WAV speech through `/v1/audio/speech`. Use the `voice` parameter to describe the voice you want, with up to 4,096 characters of input. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen3-tts).

daily.title: Seraphyn adds GPT-5.4
daily.text: The alpha `openai-seraphyn` text model adds a GPT-5.4 option with tool support. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-seraphyn).

daily.title: Dirtberry Pro makes images
daily.text: The alpha `dirtberry-pro` model adds text-to-image generation aimed at realism, pixel art, and complex scenes. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=dirtberry-pro).

daily.title: CatGPT gets Pollinations login
daily.text: Sign in with Pollinations to generate cat memes, upload a selfie, and see your Pollen balance in CatGPT. The cats also have a new cream-colored home.

daily.title: Public user snapshot endpoint
daily.text: Query the latest synced user snapshot through the read-only `d1_user_public` Tinybird endpoint. It includes names, GitHub identifiers, and tiers, but not emails or balances.
